result:
Round 255 passes. All 8 rows I could run here passed, in the real browser at both 1440×900 and 1280×720, and I found no new bugs. `browserVerified` and `realVerified` are both true.

| Row | Result |
|---|---|
| C-SCOPE-255 | PASS. HEAD is still `c65e5e9` with the same 8 status lines, and every hash and protected-file check gives rc 0. A changed only the three granted parts of doc 192. I re-ran these checks at the end, so the source did not change while I was testing. |
| C-UNIT-255 | PASS, 131/131. |
| C-SHEET-255 | PASS. The `?` sheet's scrollHeight is 1260, against 1230 at HEAD, so it is within B's new limit. The visible height is unchanged (808 / 646) and there is no sideways overflow. The 5 rows from round 254 are each at most 40 px. The other 43 rows are the same height as at HEAD, compared row by row against a HEAD copy served on port 5180. All six transport rows have the expected text, and `play-from-point` and `loop` read exactly as at HEAD. The search, Esc returning focus to "Keyboard shortcuts (?)", and the last row at 1280×720 all work. |
| C-VIDEO-ZORDER-255 | PASS, details below. |
| C-LESSON-255 | PASS. |
| AN-REVIEW-255 | PASS. |
| LAB-SMOKE-255 | PASS. Playback produces real sound at the output. The exported WAV is 48 kHz, 24-bit stereo, exactly 16.000 s, with no bad samples. Its sha256 matches round 254 (`1fea093b…033f94`). |
| Auth | PASS. In a fresh window with no login, `/studio/middle-east` shows "Sign in required" and loads no audio. `/api/studio-token` returns 401 with no token and 500 with a fake one, never 200, so premium access is not bypassed. |

**Video z-order:**
- **Docked video preview:** it sits above the timeline and the two lines never reach it, so there was nothing to compare. The report records this as layout, not as a passed comparison.
- **Video clip on the timeline:** both the insert-marker line and the playhead draw on top of it, the same as the playhead at HEAD.
- **Floating video:** both lines go underneath it, also the same as at HEAD, and clicks at the lines' position go to the video.

Ableton has no matching overlay, so no Ableton comparison applies to this row.

**Not claimed:**
- The 12 rows from round 254 are listed under `"carried"` with their evidence paths. They count only because the code is unchanged since round 254, which C-SCOPE-255 proves.
- The purchased-copy Studio row is BLOCKED because there is no backend in the cloud.
- The full test suite, typecheck, lint, build, verify and e2e smoke are left to the root gate.

C-R254-01 can now be closed. Some first runs failed for setup reasons: the server was still starting up, and my own script aimed at the wrong spot. I re-ran each one. The HEAD copy server has been stopped and its files deleted; the main server on 5173 is still up.
